description: This file defines the NetworkStatusService class in Swift, responsible for asynchronously obtaining the current network status on an iOS device using the Network framework. It includes methods for retrieving network status, handling timeouts, and managing internal state to prevent duplicate completions.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A service class providing network status updates asynchronously for iOS devices.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: An internal class managing completion state with thread safety.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status, respecting a timeout.

methods.name: payload(from:)
methods.description: Creates a payload object representing the current network path details.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Provides a default network status payload when the actual status cannot be determined within the timeout.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the internal state as completed to prevent repeated invocation.
